data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Attractions, destination, date, Search, open the attraction) and has the right destination and date parameters. It leaves out guests and filters as parameters, and it is vague about "type or browse" and "apply filters or sort", so an automation built from it would need guesswork.
